concept_checklist.title: Functions begin with a domain
concept_checklist.current_assessment_from_audit: The guide now derives the domain restrictions and distinguishes domain, codomain and range; it also contrasts a relation that is not a function.
concept_checklist.remaining_work_from_audit: Set notation and operations still need a short, usable bridge. The square-root family is not enough to teach specified versus natural domains or a freely chosen codomain.
concept_checklist.note: Audit assertions are review leads, not verified completion.

concept_checklist.title: Read a function’s shape
concept_checklist.current_assessment_from_audit: The new text handles domain symmetry, even/odd classification, the stationary but strictly increasing cubic, and a compact function-family catalog.
concept_checklist.remaining_work_from_audit: A catalog paragraph is not a lesson in recognizing piecewise, rational, trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic behavior. The visual should distinguish a formula's apparent symmetry from symmetry of its domain.
concept_checklist.note: Audit assertions are review leads, not verified completion.

concept_checklist.title: Transform and compose
